topic: Small shop and business owners in Chennai: keeping a personal SIP separate from business cash
judge_note: Counting the till every evening is a vivid scene for a Chennai shop owner, and it leads naturally to tomorrow's savings.

slides.headline: Every evening you count the till. What about tomorrow's?
slides.subhead: Business cash feeds today. A personal SIP can build for later.

slides.title: Why business owners may want a personal SIP

points.title: Business cash: today's needs
points.text: Payroll, stock, rent, GST. It must stay liquid and ready, so keep it separate.

points.title: Personal goals, long term
points.text: Retirement, your child's college. Business cash shouldn't carry these. A SIP can help fill that gap.

points.title: Same discipline, calmer future
points.text: You already run a business routine. A personal SIP is one more date on your calendar.

slides.headline: Save this for your accountant or business friend.
slides.cta: Share the idea of a separate personal pot.
slides.footnote: Separate pots keep things clear. Mutual funds are subject to market risks.

caption:
Your shop has a till.

Your future needs one too. Business cash feeds now. A personal SIP can build for later.

What does your personal savings plan look like?
